title: Decisions are D-n, kept by a reflection
quote: Make every decision a standalone doc, numbered D-1, D-2 and on, like AIPs. Each needs an automatic reflection step that can supersede an older decision or a group of them, so we always see the decisions that still hold, never outdated ones.
means: Each decision is a standalone doc D-n. Every new decision runs the reflection: it records which earlier decisions it supersedes, in whole or in part; which decisions still hold is computed, never edited.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-15 that held
